svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Pipeline
svg.desc: From an H-alpha image (2048 x 2048) to instance masks (run-length encoded) in six stages: stage 1 Dense maps: 10 U-Nets × 8 views at 2048 px, probability, view uncertainty, family gap; stage 2 Component tree: 8 thresholds, 0.2 to 0.9, 33 shape and intensity descriptors; stage 3 CNN scorer: ResNet18 on 4-channel crops, 5-fold cross-fitted; stage 4 Detector evidence: 4 detector families × 5 folds, IoU, confidence, coverage, count; stage 5 Hurdle LightGBM: P(hit) × matched IoU, 52 inputs; stage 6 Antichain selection: exact dynamic programme on the tree, keep where score > τ = 0.34. The pictures show one component tree of the test set.
